scope: Bounded read-only pinned ReleaseFast ELF review. No compile, timing, test execution, source or Git mutation.

elf.source_binding: Complete-check current build produced this executable; all source before/after final binding follows when check terminates.

source_binding_limit: Kernel source matches provided frozen hashes. Full complete-check all-source binding and family/check completion are parent-owned; no comprehensive pass asserted.

ordinary_route.dense_threshold: 0x11753e3 cmp active,129 / jae; 0x1175521 cmp active,257 / jae fallback; 129..256 uses builder256
ordinary_route.dense_gather: 0x1175a70 bulk eight-way scalar u16 symbol-index load ->u32 frequency load ->u32 compact stack store; tail0x1175b30
ordinary_route.dense_scatter: 0x1175ce0 bulk/tail0x1175ddd read byte u4 compact lengths, mask0xf, store at original symbol index
ordinary_route.caller_output_initialized: lengths[256] zero initialization covers inactive symbols; scatter touches active symbols
ordinary_route.gather_scatter_is_not_simd_gather: Actual lowering is unrolled scalar loads/stores, not vpgather instruction.

kernel256.abi: rdi compact u32 frequency pointer; rsi active length; rdx compact output lengths pointer; bool returned in al
kernel256.input_copy_scope: Kernel copies active u32 frequencies to local u64 weights and builds local indices/parents/depths; does not heap-copy raw input.
kernel256.leaf_rank_order: Equal-weight groups scanned from lowest weight toward highest; within group ascending compact rank (original deterministic symbol tie order) is preserved.
kernel256.rank_compare: Two queue heads compared by u64 weight; jbe at0x11baafa selects leaf on equality. Leaves precede appended parent nodes, so serial/rank tie rule is implicit in node order; no extra rank compare instruction claimed.
kernel256.queue_loop: 0x11baa78–0x11bab4c two inline queue pops, u64 weight sum, parents stored, parent appended, remaining decremented
kernel256.depth_guard: 0x11bab60 parent lookup; parent depth+1 encoded by shl3/add8/sar3; js at0x11bab79 ->0x11baba0 returnsfalse before depth store0x11bab7e or final output
kernel256.depth_guard_domain: Prior stored depths<=15; next1..16, sign test catches16. Static lowering evidence, not executed proof for every input.
kernel256.output_after_success: 0x11babb0 bulk/tail0x11bac50 copies leaf depths to compact output only after all depth guards pass

fallback.fill_source: Existing gather, huffman.treeCodeLengths(256,frequencies,15), scatter unchanged by this slice
fallback.generic_fallback_source: treeCodeLengths in src/huffman.zig keeps compact/package-merge policies and backref package merge for larger support
fallback.range_limit: Dense builder returnsfalse on over15 depth; caller retains bounded package-merge behavior, not truncating dense depth output.

smaller_routes.source_unchanged_record: final-kernel-static-check.json records <=64 and65..128 source routes byte-identical; this audit reads but does not execute it

local_stack.builder256_leaf_redzone: Parent array store base rbp-0x1826; stable post-prologue rsp=rbp-0x17a8; observed126 B belowrsp. Leaf has no calls; sub rsp alone is not all accessed stack.
local_stack.limit: Only explicit reservations and observed red-zone access. No complete frame/caller/descendant stack peak, heap/RSS or sizeof claim.

limitations: Static codegen/routing evidence, not exact-array correctness proof across all frequency inputs.
No target tests or benchmarks run by this audit; parent owns family/check and differential validation.
No speed ranking or cache/memory bandwidth/ISA-performance inference.
No no-allocation claim for whole encoder; kernel alone has no calls/allocator and local frequency state.
